title: A tree diagram: each node names its parent, and the engine places the nodes

relation.description: The words that join a node to its parent in its card, such as Reports to. Default: Under.

nodes.description: The nodes in order. Children show from left to right in this order.

parent.description: The id of the parent node. A node with no parent is a root.

note.description: A short second line in the box, such as who fills it.

details.description: Labelled facts in order. A list prints as bullets.
